name: Arrogant Foroxicks

generalAbilities.name: Do Your Job!
generalAbilities.description: Foroxicks commands an ally to aid him. One ally uses a reaction to move up to their Speed into an open space to flank with Foroxicks.

defensiveAbilities.name: Avenging Bite
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within reach of the Foroxicks's jaws attacks one of the warg's allies.

Effect Foroxicks makes a jaws Strike against the triggering creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Buck
defensiveAbilities.description:
DC 21 Reflex save

See rules...

Most monsters that serve as mounts can attempt to buck off unwanted or annoying riders, but most mounts will not use this reaction against a trusted creature unless the mounts are spooked or mistreated.

Trigger A creature Mounts or uses the Command an Animal action while riding the monster.

Effect The triggering creature must succeed at a Reflex saving throw against the listed DC or fall off the creature and land Prone. If the save is a critical failure, the triggering creature also takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage in addition to the normal damage for the fall.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pack Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Foroxicks's Strikes deals an extra 1d6 damage to any creature within reach of at least two of his allies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pompous Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Foroxicks becomes enraged if his silks, golden mirrors, or throne are damaged. He takes a –2 circumstance penalty to his jaws attack, but each hit deals 3 additional points of piercing damage for three rounds as he attacks with uncontrolled fury.

Effect: Pompous Rage

offensiveAbilities.name: Winter Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: Foroxicks breathes a cloud of frost in a 15 foot cone dealing 5d8 - 4 cold damage (DC 21 basic Type:reflex check save). He can't use Winter Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

description:
Wargs hunt in packs like wolves, but their penchant for taunting victims makes them easy to distinguish from their cousins. Orcs and hobgoblins frequently recruit wargs. Most wargs are amenable to this arrangement, but if food should run out, wargs are more than willing to integrate goblinoid flesh into their diet.

The warg is an intelligent and malevolent wolf that dwells among goblins, hobgoblins, orcs, and violent humanoids.
